classification: Extreme rays from the six-party section census. A certified vertex minimum qualifies for the paired catalogue regardless of order; unproven minima remain supplemental.
permutations: Lexicographic permutations g of the seven terminals; at new subset S use the old coefficient at g(S), folding by purity.
vertex_bounds: A completed unbounded search at N excludes smaller graphs: subdividing a positive edge preserves every terminal cut. A cut-support exclusion applies to all graphs through maximum_total_vertices. minimality_unproven means the retained graph is an exact witness, but its upper bound is not matched by a proved lower bound. Minimum edge counts are not claimed.
